description: Import and Export Control Department - Import Control Regulations on Payment Terms No. 17 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the promulgation of new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act, specifically the "Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No. 17 of 2022." It amends existing import license and payment regulations, establishes new payment terms for agricultural imports, and includes a detailed schedule of HS codes for regulated items. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements for import controls.
